liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat Sunflower is described as ripping; The bridge from China Cat into Rider is tight [6][7]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Bird Song is called nice by the reviewer; Bird Song is called sublime, along with Playin' in the Band, in the first set [4][6]
- **Big River** (2 reviews): Big River is described as smoking; Big River is strong, with Loser also full of great Jerry licks [5][7]
- **Loser** (1 review): Loser is called nice by the reviewer [4]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone runs about fifteen minutes and is very slow, sleepy and drugged-sounding [5]
- **Sing Me Back Home** (1 review): Sing Me Back Home coming out of The Other One is singled out as nice [4]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-09-30.sbd.clugston.8184.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 198 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Hi-fi stereo with excellent mix; reviewer prefers it to the other version listed for this date [14]
- **gd72-09-30.sbd.unknown.5681.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 202 min; rated 3.71/5 by 24 [2]. Said about its sound: Mix has very clear stereo separation, with Bobby on the right side sounding unusually crisp [5]

## Around the show

- A member of the AU concert committee helped roadies set up and dismantle the huge sound system, driving a forklift [9]
- The concert drew people from all over to AU's baseball and soccer fields [9]
- AU often had free shows, but this was at a different location with a bigger stage [10]
- Show started early while still light, with a small crowd of maybe 200, and was short [10]
- A woman danced topless at the side of the stage [10]
- Free concert for AU students; a woman's topless dancing was widely admired, and the grounds had unpleasant surprises [11]
- Felt like a private party in a moderately sized campus field [12]
- A woman did a topless strip tease, recalled as happening at the set break [12]
- Reviewer prefers the Wichita, Stanley Theatre and Palace Theatre first night shows over this one [6]
- Reviewer places the show in the tired period right after the European tour; mellow [7]
- Felt lower key than seeing the band at RFK, though the seating was better [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-09-30.sbd.clugston.8184.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: SBD >Master 7" Reels @ 7 1/2 ips [1]
- **gd72-09-30.sbd.unknown.5681.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard to MR to cassette to DAT to CD, then cleaned up and converted to SHN; via Matt Vernon; One More Saturday Night comes from a different chain, going through a second-generation cassette copy before DAT [2]
